_meta.note: Plain English. Unofficial explanations; only the official Mietspiegel is binding.

bad.title: Bathroom and toilet
bad.intro: If a feature says „bezieht sich (beides) nicht auf Gäste-WCs“ (does not refer (in either case) to guest toilets), only the main bathroom counts.

wohnung.title: Flat
wohnung.intro: Taken literally, „überwiegend“ (mostly) means: more than half, for example of the windows or rooms.

gebaeude.title: Building
gebaeude.intro:
Energy: tick either “insulation or heating system” or the features on the energy value, not both. For the energy value, up to three boxes can count: above 145, 195 and 235 or below 120, 100 and 80 kWh per m² and year (kWh/(m²a)).

The energy value covers heating and hot water and is in the building’s energy certificate (Energieausweis); ask the landlord for it. A copy helps as evidence. With an energy demand certificate (Bedarfsausweis, instead of an energy consumption certificate, Verbrauchsausweis) the limits are 20 % higher. If the hot water is produced in the flat (for example with instantaneous water heaters, Durchlauferhitzer), 20 kWh/(m²a) are added to the energy value before it is compared with the limits: under the Mietspiegel 2024 always, under the Mietspiegel 2026 only if hot water is not included in the energy value. The official notes on the group show the exact wording.

In listed buildings (Denkmalschutz), the minus features on energy do not count if energy-saving renovation would breach monument protection or would be disproportionately expensive.

umfeld.title: Surroundings
umfeld.intro: The residential area (Wohnlage: simple, medium, good) is already included in the table value. Only special features of your flat count here.

bad-m01.title: No washbasin or only a small one
bad-m01.explain: No hand washbasin in the bathroom or toilet. Or only a small basin in the bathroom: 50 cm wide or less on the outside (Mietspiegel 2024: 50 x 25 cm or smaller).
bad-m01.check: Measure the basin on the outside at the widest point, from edge to edge; for the Mietspiegel 2024, also measure the depth.
bad-m01.proof: A dated photo with a folding ruler held against it, on which you can read the number.

bad-m02.title: Toilet room without any ventilation
bad-m02.explain: The room with the toilet has neither a window nor an extractor.
bad-m02.check: Is there a window that can be opened? A fan or a ventilation shaft with a grille? If both are missing, the feature applies.
bad-m02.proof: Photos of all walls and the ceiling.

bad-m03.title: Wooden floorboards in the bathroom, not suitable for wet rooms
bad-m03.explain: The bathroom has wooden boards that are not suitable for wet rooms (nicht feuchtraumgeeignet).
bad-m03.check: Are the boards laid without tiles or a waterproof covering on top? The Mietspiegel does not define „feuchtraumgeeignet“ (suitable for wet rooms). If in doubt, ask an advice centre.
bad-m03.proof: Photos of the floor, including the gaps and any water damage.

bad-m04.title: Bathroom without proper heating
bad-m04.explain: The bathroom cannot be heated, or only with wood, coal or an electric radiant heater.
bad-m04.check: Is there a radiator that is connected to the heating? Or only a stove for wood or coal, an electric heater or nothing?
bad-m04.proof: Photos that show that there is no radiator, or which device there is.

bad-m05.title: Not enough hot water in the bathroom
bad-m05.explain: No adequate hot water supply in the bathroom, for example no central hot water supply, no instantaneous water heater (Durchlauferhitzer), no boiler with more than 60 litres.
bad-m05.check: Where does the hot water come from: from the central system, from an instantaneous water heater or from a boiler? On a boiler, the number of litres is usually on the type plate.
bad-m05.proof: A photo of the type plate of the boiler showing the number of litres.

bad-m06.title: Free-standing bathtub without a separate shower
bad-m06.explain: A free-standing bathtub (with or without panelling) and no separate shower, in a bathroom that has not been modernised.
bad-m06.check: Does the tub stand freely in the room, for example on feet, or is it only panelled at the front? Is there also a shower? The Mietspiegel does not define „nicht modernisiert“ (not modernised).
bad-m06.proof: Photos of the tub and of the whole bathroom.

bad-m07.title: Walls near the water not tiled
bad-m07.explain: The walls at the washbasin, bathtub or shower are not sufficiently tiled or protected where water splashes (splash area). The Mietspiegel 2024 only says „gefliest“ (tiled).
bad-m07.check: Are there tiles or another waterproof protection behind and next to the basin, tub and shower? How high and how wide?
bad-m07.proof: Photos of the walls with a folding ruler, so that the height of the tiles can be seen.

bad-m08.title: Bathroom with toilet but no window
bad-m08.explain: The bathroom with the toilet has no window. Does not apply to the building age class 1973 to 1990 East.
bad-m08.proof: Photos of all walls of the bathroom.

bad-m09.title: You cannot shower properly
bad-m09.explain: No way to shower, for example: no protection against splashing water (such as a shower curtain or shower screen), no holder for the shower head. In the Mietspiegel 2024 also: a very small standing area.
bad-m09.check: Does water splash into the room when you shower? Is there a holder for the shower head on the wall? The Mietspiegel only gives examples, no fixed rule.
bad-m09.proof: Photos of the tub or shower, the holder and the walls.

bad-m10.title: Small bathroom under 4 m²
bad-m10.explain: The bathroom has a floor area of less than 4 m². Does not apply to the building age class 1973 to 1990 East.
bad-m10.check: Measure the length and width at floor level and multiply length by width; for sloping or angled rooms, measure in parts. Compare with the area in the tenancy agreement or in a floor area calculation, if there is one.
bad-m10.proof: A sketch with measurements, photos with a folding ruler.

bad-p01.title: Very large or double washbasin
bad-p01.explain: A washbasin at least 80 cm wide on the outside, a double washbasin or two separate washbasins (Mietspiegel 2026: next to each other).
bad-p01.check: Measure the basin on the outside at the widest point.
bad-p01.proof: If the basin is narrower than 80 cm: a photo with a folding ruler.

bad-p02.title: Particularly high-quality bathroom fittings
bad-p02.explain: Special, high-quality fittings, for example high-quality sanitary fittings or bathroom furniture, a corner bath, a round bath; in the Mietspiegel 2026 also a real glass partition and a rain shower. The Mietspiegel does not define „hochwertig“ (high-quality).
bad-p02.check: Normal, simple fittings are not meant.
bad-p02.proof: Photos of the fittings; receipts if you installed something yourself.

bad-p03.title: Interior bathroom with modern ventilation
bad-p03.explain: The bathroom is inside the flat (without a window) and has a modern, controlled extractor, for example with a humidity sensor.
bad-p03.check: Does the fan start by itself, for example when it is humid or with the light, and does it keep running afterwards? A simple ventilation shaft is not „modern gesteuert“ (modern and controlled).
bad-p03.proof: A photo of the fan; write down when it runs.

bad-p04.title: Second toilet or toilet separate from the bathroom
bad-p04.explain: A second toilet in the flat, or the bathroom and the toilet in separate rooms.

bad-p05.title: Large bathroom over 8 m²
bad-p05.explain: At least one bathroom has a floor area of more than 8 m².
bad-p05.check: Measure at floor level: length times width.
bad-p05.proof: If the bathroom is smaller: a sketch with measurements.

bad-p06.title: Underfloor heating in the bathroom
bad-p06.check: Does the floor get warm when the heating is on? Is there a separate control for it?

bad-p07.title: High-quality tiles or wall covering in the bathroom
bad-p07.explain: High-quality wall covering and high-quality floor covering in the bathroom. Does not apply to the building age classes from 2010 (Mietspiegel 2024: not to 2016 to 2022). The Mietspiegel does not define „hochwertig“ (high-quality).
bad-p07.check: Are the walls and floor made of particularly good materials, for example natural stone? Taken literally, simple standard tiles are not „hochwertig“.
bad-p07.proof: Photos of the walls and floor, including any damage.

bad-p08.title: Wall-hung toilet with concealed cistern
bad-p08.explain: A toilet that hangs on the wall, with the cistern inside the wall (does not apply to the building age classes from 2002). Or a high-quality floor-standing toilet.
bad-p08.check: Does the toilet hang on the wall without a foot, and is the cistern hidden? The Mietspiegel does not define what a „hochwertiges“ (high-quality) floor-standing toilet is.

bad-p09.title: Towel radiator in the bathroom
bad-p09.explain: A radiator that is also a towel rail (Strukturheizkörper). Applies to the building age classes up to and including 2001; if it can also run on electricity, to all building years.
bad-p09.check: Does the radiator have pipes or bars for towels? Does it have a cable or an electric heating element?

bad-p10.title: Shower in addition to the bathtub
bad-p10.explain: Next to the bathtub, a separate, additional shower tray or shower cubicle.
bad-p10.check: A shower in the tub does not count.

bad-p11.title: Level-access shower
bad-p11.explain: A shower without a step, at floor level. A flat shower tray up to 3 cm deep also counts.
bad-p11.check: For a shower tray, measure the height from the floor to the top edge.
bad-p11.proof: A photo with a folding ruler at the edge of the shower tray.

gebaeude-m01.title: Staircase and entrance in poor condition
gebaeude-m01.explain: The staircase and the entrance area are mostly in poor condition.
gebaeude-m01.check: Is there major damage to walls, stairs, banisters, letterboxes or lighting? The Mietspiegel does not define „schlecht“ (poor).
gebaeude-m01.proof: Dated photos; letters in which you reported the damage.

gebaeude-m02.title: No cellar or storage room outside the flat
gebaeude-m02.explain: No storage room outside the flat that only you use and that costs nothing extra, for example no lockable cellar.
gebaeude-m02.check: Does a cellar room or attic room belong to the flat? Is it in the tenancy agreement? Does it cost extra? Can you lock it?

gebaeude-m03.title: Front door always open to everyone
gebaeude-m03.explain: The building entrance (Mietspiegel 2026: building entrance or staircase) is freely accessible from outside at any time: anyone can get into the building without a key and without ringing.
gebaeude-m03.check: Can the front door be opened from outside without a key at different times, for example because the lock is broken or missing? Is it regularly left open?
gebaeude-m03.proof: Dated photos and videos of the door; reports of defects.

gebaeude-m04.title: Building in poor structural condition
gebaeude-m04.explain: The building is in a poor state of repair, for example walls that are permanently damp (also in the cellar), major damage to the plaster, considerable damage to the roof.
gebaeude-m04.check: Write down since when the damage has been there.
gebaeude-m04.proof: Dated photos, reports of defects to the landlord and his replies.

gebaeude-m05.title: Flat in a side wing or rear building
gebaeude-m05.explain: The flat is in the side wing or in the cross building (rear building, Hinterhaus), and the buildings there stand very close together (dense development).
gebaeude-m05.check: Is the courtyard narrow? The Mietspiegel does not define „verdichtet“ (dense).
gebaeude-m05.proof: Photos of the courtyard, a site plan or a section of a map.

gebaeude-m06.title: 5th floor or higher without a lift
gebaeude-m06.explain: The flat is on the 5th upper floor or higher, and there is no passenger lift. Does not apply to the building age classes up to 1949.
gebaeude-m06.check: The ground floor does not count as an upper floor.

gebaeude-m07.title: No intercom with door opener
gebaeude-m07.explain: No intercom (or two-way intercom) with an electric door opener.
gebaeude-m07.check: Can you talk to visitors at the front door from the flat and open the front door with a button?

gebaeude-m08.title: Poor insulation or old heating system
gebaeude-m08.explain: Inadequate thermal insulation, or a heating system with poor efficiency that was installed before 1995.
gebaeude-m08.check: Ask for the year the heating system was installed; it is often on the type plate. The Mietspiegel does not define „unzureichend“ (inadequate). If there is an energy certificate (Energieausweis), the energy value is usually clearer.
gebaeude-m08.proof: A photo of the type plate of the heating, the energy certificate.

gebaeude-p01.title: Lockable bicycle room or bicycle stands
gebaeude-p01.explain: A lockable, easily accessible room for bicycles in the building, or bicycle parking spaces outside on the property where you can lock your bike. They must be large enough.
gebaeude-p01.check: Can you reach the room without many steps? Is there enough space for the residents’ bikes? The Mietspiegel does not define „ausreichend“ (enough).
gebaeude-p01.proof: Photos, for example if the room is always full or has steps.

gebaeude-p02.title: Common room, guest flat or drying room
gebaeude-p02.explain: Additional rooms outside the flat that can be reached on foot and used to a reasonable extent, for example a common room; in the Mietspiegel 2026 also a guest flat or drying room.
gebaeude-p02.check: Are you allowed to use the rooms? Are they open, or do you get a key?

gebaeude-p03.title: Prestigious entrance and staircase
gebaeude-p03.explain: A prestigious (repräsentativ) or high-quality renovated entrance area and staircase, for example mirrors, marble, special lighting, high-quality paint or wall covering, runners in the whole hall and stair area.
gebaeude-p03.check: Taken literally, normal, clean paintwork is not „repräsentativ“.
gebaeude-p03.proof: Photos of the entrance and staircase.

gebaeude-p04.title: Building in particularly good condition
gebaeude-p04.explain: The building or part of the building where your flat is has an above-average state of repair, for example a renewed façade or renewed roof. Applies to the building age classes up to and including 2015.
gebaeude-p04.check: Were the façade or roof renewed in recent years? Is there visible damage? The Mietspiegel does not define „überdurchschnittlich“ (above average).
gebaeude-p04.proof: Dated photos of damage, reports of defects.

gebaeude-p05.title: Video intercom
gebaeude-p05.explain: An intercom (or two-way intercom) with a video picture and an electric door opener.

gebaeude-p06.title: Lift even in a low building
gebaeude-p06.explain: A passenger lift, even though the building has fewer than five upper floors. Does not apply to the building age classes from 2010.
gebaeude-p06.check: Count the upper floors without the ground floor.

gebaeude-p07.title: Access to the building with almost no steps
gebaeude-p07.explain: At most one step to get into the building and at most one step to get to the flat, including the staircase.
gebaeude-p07.check: Count the steps from the street to the front door and from the front door to the flat door. The Mietspiegel does not say whether a lift makes up for the steps in the staircase.

gebaeude-p08.title: Additional insulation or new heating system
gebaeude-p08.explain: Thermal insulation in addition to the original building fabric or a modern heating system that was installed in 2009 or later. The building or flat must have been completed „vor diesem Zeitpunkt“ (before this point in time). The Mietspiegel does not say clearly whether „before 2009“ or „before the installation“ is meant.
gebaeude-p08.check: Was the building insulated later, for example the façade? The year the heating system was installed is often on the type plate.
gebaeude-p08.proof: Energy certificate, a photo of the type plate of the heating.

kueche-m01.title: Kitchen without a window and without ventilation
kueche-m01.explain: The kitchen has no window and no adequate extractor.
kueche-m01.check: Is there a fan or shaft that takes the air outside? The Mietspiegel does not define „ausreichend“ (adequate).
kueche-m01.proof: Photos of all walls and the ceiling of the kitchen.

kueche-m02.title: No cooker, or cooker without an oven
kueche-m02.explain: No way to cook, or only a gas or electric cooker without an oven.
kueche-m02.check: A cooker that you bought yourself does not count.
kueche-m02.proof: The handover report (Übergabeprotokoll) or tenancy agreement that says what was in the kitchen; photos from when you moved in.

kueche-m03.title: No sink in the kitchen
kueche-m03.check: A sink that you installed and paid for yourself does not count.
kueche-m03.proof: Handover report, photos from when you moved in, the invoice for a sink you bought yourself, witnesses.

kueche-m04.title: Not enough hot water in the kitchen
kueche-m04.explain: No adequate hot water supply in the kitchen, for example no central hot water supply, no instantaneous water heater (Durchlauferhitzer), no boiler.
kueche-m04.check: Does hot water come out at the sink, and where from?
kueche-m04.proof: Photos of the sink and of the device under or above the sink.

kueche-m05.title: Kitchen without proper heating
kueche-m05.explain: The kitchen cannot be heated, or only with wood or coal.
kueche-m05.check: Is there a radiator that is connected to the heating?
kueche-m05.proof: Photos that show that there is no radiator.

kueche-m06.title: No space or connection for a dishwasher
kueche-m06.explain: A dishwasher cannot be put in or connected in the kitchen.
kueche-m06.check: Is there space, a water connection and a drain, for example a valve with a connection under the sink?
kueche-m06.proof: Photos under the sink and of the place where the machine would have to stand, with measurements.

kueche-m07.title: No tiles on the wall behind the work area
kueche-m07.explain: There are no tiles on the wall in the work area and no comparable protection, for example a glass or plastic panel.
kueche-m07.check: Look behind the cooker, sink and worktop: are there tiles or a washable panel?
kueche-m07.proof: Photos of the wall in the work area.

kueche-p01.title: High-quality kitchen floor
kueche-p01.explain: A kitchen floor in good condition made of high-quality tiles, high-quality linoleum, high-quality laminate for wet rooms, parquet or terrazzo. Applies to the building age classes up to and including 2009. The Mietspiegel does not define „hochwertig“ (high-quality).
kueche-p01.check: Is the floor free of cracks, holes or heavy wear?
kueche-p01.proof: Dated photos of damage to the floor.

kueche-p02.title: Large separate kitchen of 14 m² or more
kueche-p02.explain: A separate kitchen in its own room with a floor area of at least 14 m².
kueche-p02.check: Measure at floor level: length times width.
kueche-p02.proof: If the kitchen is smaller: a sketch with measurements.

kueche-p03.title: Fitted kitchen with cupboards, cooker and sink
kueche-p03.explain: A fitted kitchen (Einbauküche) with wall cupboards and base cupboards, a cooker and a sink.
kueche-p03.check: If you took over the kitchen from the previous tenant, get advice.
kueche-p03.proof: Handover report, tenancy agreement, invoices and photos from when you moved in.

kueche-p04.title: Ceramic glass or induction hob
kueche-p04.explain: A ceramic glass hob (Ceran) or an induction hob. Applies to the building age classes up to and including 2001.
kueche-p04.check: Does the cooker have a smooth glass surface instead of metal hotplates?

kueche-p06.title: Fridge, freezer or dishwasher
kueche-p06.explain: The landlord provides a fridge, a freezer, a chest freezer or a dishwasher.
kueche-p06.check: Is the appliance listed in the tenancy agreement or in the handover report?
kueche-p06.proof: Invoices for appliances you bought yourself.

kueche-p07.title: Free-standing kitchen block (kitchen island)
kueche-p07.explain: A kitchen block that stands freely in the room, with a worktop and a cooker or sink.
kueche-p07.check: Can you walk around the block?

umfeld-m01.title: Particularly noisy location
umfeld-m01.explain: The flat is in a particularly noisy location, for example on a main road or right next to an airport, with unpleasant noise and dust. Large factories and industrial plants, noise from businesses, restaurants or parties can also be the cause.
umfeld-m01.check: The Mietspiegel refers to the strategic noise maps (Strategische Lärmkarten) of the Senate Department for the Environment. There you can see the noise at the façade of your building: www.berlin.de/sen/uvk/umwelt/laerm/laermminderungsplanung-berlin/laermkarten/. Write down where the noise comes from and when.
umfeld-m01.proof: A printout of the noise map for your address, a noise log with date and time, photos or videos.

umfeld-m02.title: Particularly strong smells in the area
umfeld-m02.explain: The location is particularly affected by smells. The Mietspiegel gives no examples and no limit values.
umfeld-m02.check: Does something nearby regularly smell strongly, for example a business? How often and how strongly?
umfeld-m02.proof: A smell log with date and time, photos of the source, complaints.

umfeld-m03.title: No space for bicycles on the property
umfeld-m03.explain: There is nowhere on the property to park bicycles.
umfeld-m03.check: Is there a place in the courtyard or in the building that the residents are allowed to use?
umfeld-m03.proof: Photos of the courtyard; the house rules (Hausordnung) if bicycles are not allowed there.

umfeld-m04.title: Very neglected surroundings
umfeld-m04.explain: Only in the Mietspiegel 2024: location in very neglected surroundings. The Mietspiegel 2024 gives no examples.
umfeld-m04.check: Are there, for example, abandoned buildings, a lot of rubbish, broken paths? The Mietspiegel does not define „stark vernachlässigt“ (very neglected).

umfeld-p01.title: Particularly quiet location
umfeld-p01.explain: The flat is in a particularly quiet location, for example on a traffic-calmed street, next to a park-like area, or on a street with structural limits such as bollards, a narrowed road or planting.
umfeld-p01.check: How loud is it at your windows, during the day and at night? The Senate’s strategic noise maps (Strategische Lärmkarten) show the traffic noise at the façade. The Mietspiegel does not define „besonders ruhig“ (particularly quiet).
umfeld-p01.proof: A printout of the noise map, a noise log with date and time.

umfeld-p02.title: Attractively designed property
umfeld-p02.explain: Elaborately designed surroundings on the property, for example a children’s playground (only if the building was completed before 2003; Mietspiegel 2024: before 2002), benches or quiet areas, well-paved paths with green spaces and lighting.
umfeld-p02.check: Only what is on the property counts, not the public park next door. What condition is it in? The Mietspiegel does not define „aufwändig“ (elaborate).

umfeld-p03.title: Parking from the landlord nearby
umfeld-p03.explain: The landlord provides parking spaces for cars nearby, in sufficient numbers.
umfeld-p03.check: The Landgericht Berlin (Berlin Regional Court) decided on the Mietspiegel 2017: spaces that cost extra can also count, but only if, when the rent increase demand (Mieterhöhungsverlangen) reached you, you had actually rented a space from the landlord or he had offered you one before (judgment of 16.10.2018, 67 S 150/18). Other courts may see it differently.
umfeld-p03.proof: Letters or offers from the landlord about parking spaces.

umfeld-p04.title: Own garden or tenants’ garden
umfeld-p04.explain: A garden only for you, or a tenants’ garden free of charge. Or a garden that belongs to the flat and can be reached directly from it.
umfeld-p04.check: Is the garden in the tenancy agreement? Do you pay extra? Do you share it with others?

umfeld-p05.title: Preferred city-centre location
umfeld-p05.explain: Only in the Mietspiegel 2024: preferred city location, close to well-known places for shopping, services and living that are important beyond the region.
umfeld-p05.check: Is the flat right at a well-known, large shopping or business location? The Mietspiegel 2024 does not say exactly what counts.

wohnung-m01.title: Mostly single-glazed windows
wohnung-m01.explain: Most windows have only one pane of glass (single glazing, Einfachverglasung). Box-type double windows (Doppel-Kastenfenster), i.e. two windows one behind the other with a gap between them, are not meant.
wohnung-m01.check: Count all the windows: how many have only one pane in a frame? You can recognise a box window by the fact that you open two window sashes one behind the other.
wohnung-m01.proof: A list of all windows per room, photos.

wohnung-m02.title: Electrics inadequate or outdated
wohnung-m02.explain: Inadequate electrical installation, for example no adequate electrical riser (the main cable in the building to the flat) and/or no installation according to VDE rules, such as no RCD switch (FI-Schalter, residual current device) or no equipotential bonding (Potentialausgleich: connection of metal parts such as pipes to the earthing).
wohnung-m02.check: Is there an RCD switch (FI-Schalter) in the fuse box? It usually has a test button marked „T“. Do fuses trip when several appliances run at the same time, for example a kettle and a washing machine? Only a qualified electrician can say for sure whether the installation meets the VDE rules.
wohnung-m02.proof: A photo of the fuse box, dated notes on tripped fuses, letters to the landlord about problems.

wohnung-m03.title: Electric cables mostly visible on the wall
wohnung-m03.explain: The electric cables mostly run visibly on top of the plaster, not inside the wall.
wohnung-m03.check: Do cables or cable ducts run openly on walls or ceilings?

wohnung-m04.title: Water pipes mostly visible on the wall
wohnung-m04.explain: Supply pipes and waste water pipes (sanitary pipes) mostly lie visibly on top of the plaster. Heating pipes are not meant.
wohnung-m04.proof: Photos of the pipes in the bathroom and kitchen.

wohnung-m05.title: No space for the washing machine
wohnung-m05.explain: The washing machine can be neither set up nor connected in the bathroom or in the kitchen.
wohnung-m05.check: Is there a place there with a tap and a drain where a normal washing machine fits?
wohnung-m05.proof: Photos and measurements of the bathroom and kitchen, a photo of the connections or of the place where they are missing.

wohnung-m06.title: Poor layout of the flat
wohnung-m06.explain: Poor floor plan (layout), for example a „trapped“ room (gefangenes Zimmer: can only be reached through another room) and/or a walk-through room (Durchgangszimmer: you have to go through it to get to another room).
wohnung-m06.check: Draw a simple plan of the flat. The Mietspiegel only gives examples; in a dispute, the court decides whether other floor plans are also „schlecht“ (poor).
wohnung-m06.proof: A floor plan from the rental documents or your own sketch with doors.

wohnung-m07.title: No balcony, no terrace, no loggia
wohnung-m07.explain: No balcony, no (roof) terrace, no loggia, no winter garden or roof garden. Does not apply if a balcony is not possible or not allowed for structural and/or legal reasons.
wohnung-m07.check: You usually cannot check yourself whether a balcony would be structurally or legally impossible (for example because the building is listed). The Mietspiegel does not say who has to prove this in a dispute. Get advice.

wohnung-m08.title: Ground floor without protection against break-ins or views
wohnung-m08.explain: Only in the Mietspiegel 2026: a flat on the ground floor where not all windows have protection against break-ins and/or against people looking in from outside, for example bars, roller shutters, window alarms.
wohnung-m08.check: Check every window. If no window is protected, the feature certainly applies. If only some of the windows lack protection, it is unclear whether the feature applies.
wohnung-m08.proof: Photos of every window from inside and outside.

wohnung-p01.title: Storage room or built-in wardrobe in the flat
wohnung-p01.explain: A storage room in the flat (Mietspiegel 2026: at least 1 m² floor area) or a built-in wardrobe.
wohnung-p01.check: Measure the floor area of the storage room.
wohnung-p01.proof: Measurements of the storage room; receipts if you installed the wardrobe yourself.

wohnung-p02.title: Large balcony, terrace or loggia
wohnung-p02.explain: A large, spacious balcony, a (roof) terrace, a loggia or a winter garden or roof garden of 4 m² or more (Mietspiegel 2026: 4 m² floor area or more).
wohnung-p02.check: Measure at floor level: length times depth.
wohnung-p02.proof: If it is smaller: measurements and a photo with a folding ruler.

wohnung-p04.title: Stucco or panelling in good condition
wohnung-p04.explain: Elaborate covering on ceilings and/or walls in good condition, for example stucco or wood panelling, in most of the living rooms.
wohnung-p04.check: In how many living rooms is there stucco or panelling? Is it well preserved, or damaged, painted over or only a narrow border? The Mietspiegel does not define „aufwändig“ (elaborate).
wohnung-p04.proof: Photos of the ceilings in every room, including damage.

wohnung-p05.title: Heating pipes mostly not visible
wohnung-p05.explain: The heating pipes are mostly not visible (Mietspiegel 2026: not visible on top of the plaster). Applies to the building age classes up to and including 1990.
wohnung-p05.check: In how many rooms do pipes to the radiators run openly along the wall?
wohnung-p05.proof: Photos of the pipes in every room.

wohnung-p06.title: Roller shutters or external sun protection
wohnung-p06.explain: Mietspiegel 2026: protection against the sun (shading) fitted on the outside of most of the windows in the living rooms, for example roller shutters. Mietspiegel 2024: only „Rollläden“ (roller shutters).
wohnung-p06.check: How many windows in the living rooms have roller shutters, awnings or external blinds on the outside? Blinds fitted on the inside do not count.
wohnung-p06.proof: A list of the windows, photos from outside.

wohnung-p07.title: One room larger than 40 m²
wohnung-p07.check: Measure your largest room: length times width.

wohnung-p08.title: Flat with few barriers
wohnung-p08.explain: Low-barrier: no thresholds in the flat, a transition to the balcony or terrace with hardly any threshold, enough space to move around. The Mietspiegel 2024 also says: „und/oder barrierearme Badgestaltung“ (and/or low-barrier bathroom design). The Mietspiegel does not say how high a threshold may be.
wohnung-p08.check: How high is the step to the balcony? Can you get through doors and the hallway with a walking frame or wheelchair?
wohnung-p08.proof: Photos of the thresholds with a folding ruler.

wohnung-p09.title: High-quality floor in most living rooms
wohnung-p09.explain: High-quality parquet, natural or artificial stone, tiles or an equivalent floor in most of the living rooms. In the Mietspiegel 2026 the hallway counts, the kitchen and bathroom do not. The Mietspiegel does not define „hochwertig“ (high-quality) or „gleichwertig“ (equivalent).
wohnung-p09.check: Which floor is in which room, and what condition is it in?
wohnung-p09.proof: Photos of the floors, the handover report, receipts for floors you laid yourself.

wohnung-p10.title: New thermal or soundproof windows
wohnung-p10.explain: For buildings or flats completed before 2002: mostly thermal insulation glazing or soundproof windows. In the Mietspiegel 2026 in each case installed in 2002 or later; in the Mietspiegel 2024, „Einbau ab 2002“ (installed from 2002) is only stated for thermal insulation glazing.
wohnung-p10.check: When were the windows installed? There is often a print with the year or manufacturer in the space between the panes. Count the new windows.
wohnung-p10.proof: Photos of the prints in the space between the panes.

wohnung-p11.title: Flat door with extra protection against break-ins
wohnung-p11.explain: Additional protection against break-ins on a reinforced flat door, for example high-quality door guards (Sperrbügel) and/or multi-point locks.
wohnung-p11.check: Both are required: the extra protection and a reinforced door.
wohnung-p11.proof: Photos of the door and the lock.

checker.received_help: The day the letter was in your letterbox or post office box, not the date on the letter.
checker.last_change: Since when has your rent applied, not counting increases for modernisation or service charges?
checker.last_change_help: The day from which you had to pay more after the last increase. If there has been no increase yet: the day from which you had to pay rent under the agreement; then tick the box below. Increases for modernisation or service charges do not count.
checker.current_rent: Your current net cold rent (Nettokaltmiete) per month
checker.current_rent_help: Without service charges and heating costs.
checker.rent_3y_ago: Net cold rent three years before the day the new rent is to apply
checker.rent_3y_ago_help: Your net cold rent on {date3y}. If you have only lived there since that day or for a shorter time, enter the rent when you moved in. Leave empty only if your rent has stayed the same since that day.
checker.increases_559_560: Increases of the net cold rent after modernisation (§ 559 BGB) in these three years (€ per month)
checker.demanded_rent: New net cold rent that the landlord demands
checker.ovm_per_sqm: Local comparative rent (ortsübliche Vergleichsmiete) in € per m² (from the calculator)
checker.requested_effective: From when does the landlord want the new rent?
checker.disclaimer: All dates are calendar dates. We move only the landlord’s deadline to sue to the next working day if it ends on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Berlin (§ 193 BGB); for your own deadline we only mention that day as a note. Plan your deadlines with the calendar date and preferably reply a few days earlier.

sperrfrist_fail.title: The demand may have come too early
sperrfrist_fail.text: By the fixed calculation rule and your details, the letter reached you less than one year after the last rent increase. According to the Federal Court of Justice (Bundesgerichtshof), it is then invalid (§ 558 Abs. 1 Satz 2 BGB; BGH, VIII ZR 178/03). Check the dates carefully and get advice before you consent.

sperrfrist_from_start.title: The demand may have come too early (first year of the tenancy)
sperrfrist_from_start.text: According to your details, there has been no rent increase yet, and the letter reached you in the first year of the tenancy. The law only says: one year after the last rent increase at the earliest (§ 558 Abs. 1 Satz 2 BGB). According to a widely held view in the legal literature, the year then counts from the start of the tenancy; the demand would be too early. We have not found a decision of the Federal Court of Justice (Bundesgerichtshof) on this. Check the dates carefully and get advice before you consent.

wartefrist_postponed.title: The new rent can only apply later
wartefrist_postponed.text: Based on your details, your rent will not yet have been unchanged for 15 months on the date of the increase. Then the increase can apply from {effective} at the earliest (§ 558 Abs. 1 Satz 1 BGB). We have not found any decision of the Federal Court of Justice that clarifies what a date named too early means for the demand. Get advice.

over_cap.title: Above the cap (Kappungsgrenze)
over_cap.text: Based on your details, the rent demanded is above the cap of {rate} in three years (§ 558 Abs. 3 BGB). By calculation, this limit allows at most {cap_rent}.

over_ovm.title: Above the comparative rent
over_ovm.text: The rent demanded is above the comparative rent from your calculation with the Mietspiegel ({ovm_rent}). This calculation is based on your details about the features; the landlord may see features differently. In a dispute, the court decides.

within_limits.title: Based on your details, no limit is exceeded
within_limits.text: Based on your details, the rent demanded is neither above the cap nor above the comparative rent from your calculation. This is no guarantee. Check your details, especially the features, the living space and the rent from three years ago.

no_ovm.title: Comparative rent missing
no_ovm.text: Without a comparative rent or living space, we only check the cap and the deadlines. You can estimate the comparative rent with the calculator.

requested_too_early.title: The date named is too early
requested_too_early.text: The landlord names an earlier date than the law allows. The higher rent can apply from {effective} at the earliest (§ 558b Abs. 1 BGB, § 558 Abs. 1 Satz 1 BGB). Whether the demand is still valid depends on the individual case. Get advice.

need_rent_3y.title: Rent from three years ago missing
need_rent_3y.text: Your rent may have changed in the last three years, or the day of the last change is missing. Without the rent on {base_date} we cannot calculate the cap reliably. Enter this rent, or the rent when you moved in if you have lived there for less than three years.

no_last_change.title: Day of the last rent increase missing
no_last_change.text: Without the day since which your current rent has applied, we cannot check the one-year blocking period (Sperrfrist) and the 15-month waiting period (Wartefrist). Enter the day of the last increase or, if there has been none yet, the start of the tenancy agreement.

over_lwu.title: Above the commitments of the state-owned companies
over_lwu.text: Based on your details, the rent demanded is above the commitments of the state-owned housing companies (landeseigene Wohnungsunternehmen): at most 11 % in three years and at most €50, €75 or €100 more, depending on the living space. The calculated maximum is {lwu_cap} (euro limit calculated for this increase only). The commitments are voluntary; whether they can be enforced in court is unclear. Contact the ombudsman office (Ombudsstelle, www.ombud-lwu.de) or an advice centre.

checker.increases_559_560_help: Only increases of the cold rent after a modernisation, not changes to your advance payments for service charges or heating costs. If your rent includes a flat rate for service charges (gross rent, Bruttomiete), increases of that flat rate count too. If you are unsure, get advice.
checker.requested_effective_help: If the letter names a date for the new rent, enter it here.
checker.area_help: What counts is the real living space, not the number in the tenancy agreement.

zustimmung.title: Consent (Zustimmung)
zustimmung.when: If you have checked the increase and think the full amount is correct, for example: the new rent is not above the local comparative rent and not above the cap (Kappungsgrenze), and the waiting periods have been kept.
zustimmung.risks: Once your consent has reached the landlord, you cannot take it back. It can be challenged (anfechten) only in exceptional cases, for example deliberate deception.
zustimmung.explain: Enter your current net cold rent (Nettokaltmiete), the new rent and the date from which you pay, exactly as in the landlord’s letter. The letter says expressly that nothing else in the tenancy agreement changes. If your agreement has a gross or all-inclusive rent (Brutto- oder Inklusivmiete) instead of a net cold rent, get advice first.

teilzustimmung.title: Partial consent (Teilweise Zustimmung)
teilzustimmung.when: If you think only part of the increase is justified, for example because the comparative rent by your calculation is between your current rent and the rent demanded.
teilzustimmung.risks: You cannot take back a partial consent either. Only consent to an amount you have calculated carefully and are sure is correct, and get advice. If you pay by direct debit (Lastschrift), check your account.
teilzustimmung.explain: Enter your current net cold rent, the rent you consent to, and the date. You can name features that you see differently from the landlord, but you do not have to. The list is expressly „nicht abschließend“ (not exhaustive): you can name further points later. The letter says expressly that nothing else in the tenancy agreement changes.

ablehnung.title: Refusal (Ablehnung)
ablehnung.when: If you do not want to consent, for example because you think the increase is too high or the letter has errors.
ablehnung.risks: A refusal does not end the matter: the landlord can sue for consent within three months after the end of your deadline. If you get post from the court, go to an advice service at once. You often have only 2 weeks to reply to the court (§ 276 ZPO); otherwise it can decide without you (§ 331 ZPO). Whoever loses the court case pays the costs (§ 91 ZPO). If the landlord wins, your consent counts as given as soon as nothing more can be done against the judgment (final and binding, Rechtskraft, § 894 ZPO). Then you owe the higher rent from the date of the increase, that is, also for the months of the court case (§ 558b Abs. 1 BGB); put the money for this aside. Until the decision, with an increase under § 558 BGB you pay the previous rent, not the higher one. This does not apply to modernisation, service charges, index or graduated rent or “cost rent” (Kostenmiete) in old social housing. If you pay by direct debit, check your account.
ablehnung.explain: The law does not require you to give reasons. But you can name features from the Orientierungshilfe that you see differently: plus features that the landlord has applied and that you do not accept, and minus features that he has not taken into account. You do not have to send a refusal: if you do nothing, you have not consented either. But a letter makes your position clear.

nachfrage.title: Question about the features
nachfrage.when: If the letter does not say which features the landlord has applied, or if you want to check details such as the living space, residential area (Wohnlage) or building age.
nachfrage.risks: Asking does not stop your deadline: the deadline for consent keeps running until the end of the second calendar month after receipt (Zugang). The landlord does not have to reply; do not wait too long for an answer.
nachfrage.explain: You ask how the landlord has classified your flat, and you neither consent nor refuse. Under „Weitere Fragen“ (further questions) you can add your own questions, for example asking for a copy of the energy certificate (Energieausweis).

fields.tenant_name: Your name (if there are several tenants, all names)
fields.landlord_name: Name of the landlord or property management
fields.new_rent: New net cold rent according to the landlord (per month)
fields.effective: From when do you pay the new rent?
fields.current_rent: Your current net cold rent (per month)
fields.agreed_rent: Net cold rent you consent to (per month)
fields.disputed_plus: The landlord’s plus features that you do not accept
fields.missing_minus: Minus features the landlord has not taken into account
fields.tenant_name_help: As in the tenancy agreement. If several people signed the agreement, all of them should sign.
fields.received_help: All deadlines depend on this day. Write it down and keep the envelope.
fields.contract_number_help: Often at the top of the landlord’s letter.
fields.agreed_rent_help: Only an amount you are sure is correct. You are bound by it.
fields.effective_help: The date from the landlord’s letter. The new rent applies at the earliest from the start of the third calendar month after receipt, and only if on that day the rent has been unchanged for 15 months; otherwise a later day applies. ‘Check deadlines and limits’ enters the latest of these days here. Check it.
fields.disputed_plus_help: Only features that you have checked yourself.
fields.missing_minus_help: Only features that you have checked in your flat and can prove.
fields.own_text_help: We do not check this text; it goes into the letter unchanged. Only write facts that are true. A consent must not contain conditions or a counter-offer („nur wenn …“, “only if …”); otherwise it can count as a refusal.
fields.current_rent_help: Without service charges and heating costs.

send.title: How to send the letter
send.text: Sign the letter. Send it in a way that lets you prove later that it arrived, for example by registered mail with proof of delivery (Einwurf-Einschreiben), or hand it in together with a witness. Keep a copy. The letter must arrive before your deadline ends.

mietspiegel_choice.title: Which Mietspiegel applies?
mietspiegel_choice.text: What counts is the day the rent increase demand (Mieterhöhungsverlangen) reaches you (receipt, Zugang). The local comparative rent is determined for this day (BGH, VIII ZR 22/20, Rn. 29). Usually the Mietspiegel of that day applies: from 28.05.2026 the Mietspiegel 2026, from 30.05.2024 to 27.05.2026 the Mietspiegel 2024. Note: if the letter arrived between 01.09.2025 and 27.05.2026, a court may also use the Mietspiegel 2026 or add a surcharge (LG Berlin, 65 S 527/13; BGH, VIII ZR 295/15). In that case, calculate with both. For the rent brake (Mietpreisbremse), on the other hand, the start of the tenancy counts.

ovm.title: Local comparative rent (ortsübliche Vergleichsmiete)
ovm.text: The rent that is usual in Berlin for similar flats (§ 558 Abs. 2 BGB). The new rent must not be higher than this. The calculator takes the value from your Mietspiegel field and places it in the range with the Orientierungshilfe; the result is an estimate based on your details.

netting.title: How the range is applied
netting.text: In each of the five groups, you count plus and minus features. More plus: the group counts as plus. More minus: as minus. Equal: 0. Then one plus group and one minus group cancel each other out. Each remaining plus group moves the value up by one fifth of the distance from the average value to the upper value, each remaining minus group moves it down by one fifth of the distance from the average value to the lower value (Mietspiegel No. 10.3). Example: 3 plus groups and 2 minus groups result in 1 plus group. This is not 20 % more rent. The Mietspiegel does not say whether to round per group or once; differences of up to 2 cents per m² are possible.

consent_deadline.title: Your deadline for consent
consent_deadline.text: You have time until the end of the second calendar month after the month in which the letter arrived (§ 558b Abs. 2 BGB). Your reply should reach the landlord by this day. If it falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Berlin, the wording of § 193 BGB moves the end to the next working day. We have not found a court decision on exactly this point; do not rely on it.

effective.title: From when the new rent applies
effective.text: If you consent, you pay the higher rent from the start of the third calendar month after receipt (§ 558b Abs. 1 BGB), or from a later date the landlord names. If on that date the rent has not yet been unchanged for 15 months, the increase applies at the earliest when the 15 months are over (§ 558 Abs. 1 Satz 1 BGB).

sue_deadline.title: Deadline for the landlord to sue
sue_deadline.text: If you do not consent, or only consent in part, the landlord can sue for consent within three months after the end of your deadline (§ 558b Abs. 2 BGB). If this deadline to sue ends on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Berlin, the landlord has until the next working day (§ 193 BGB). It is enough if the claim reaches the court by then and is served soon afterwards (§ 167 ZPO); that is why we show the later date. If the end of your own deadline already falls on such a day, to be safe, we count the three months from the next working day; the date may then be a few days later. After that, the landlord can no longer sue for this increase; a new demand is still possible.

termination_declare_by.title: Special termination: deadline (common interpretation)
termination_declare_by.text: After a rent increase demand you can terminate the tenancy with extraordinary notice until the end of the second month after receipt (§ 561 BGB). Here we show the end of the second calendar month. We have not found this reading confirmed in any official source; it is better to use the safe date. We do not move this date to a working day either.

termination_safe_by.title: Special termination: safe date
termination_safe_by.text: If your notice of termination reaches the landlord by this day (two months from receipt), you are on the safe side (§ 561 BGB), even if the day is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday: it is not settled whether the deadline then moves; do not count on it. The notice must be on paper and signed (§ 568 Abs. 1 BGB). The rent increase then does not apply.

termination_ends.title: End of the tenancy after special termination
termination_ends.text: The tenancy ends at the end of the second month after the month in which your notice arrives (§ 561 Abs. 1 BGB). The date shown applies if the notice arrives on the last possible day; if you give notice earlier, it ends earlier.

sperrfrist_earliest_received.title: One-year blocking period (Sperrfrist)
sperrfrist_earliest_received.text: A rent increase demand may reach you one year after the last rent increase at the earliest (§ 558 Abs. 1 Satz 2 BGB), counted from the day that increase took effect (BGH, VIII ZR 141/09, Rn. 18). If it arrives earlier, it is invalid (BGH, VIII ZR 178/03). If there has been no rent increase yet, according to a widely held view in the legal literature the year counts from the start of the tenancy; we have not found a decision of the Federal Court of Justice (Bundesgerichtshof) on this. Increases after a modernisation or for service charges (§§ 559 to 560 BGB) do not count.

wartefrist_earliest_effective.title: 15-month waiting period (Wartefrist)
wartefrist_earliest_effective.text: The new rent may only apply when the rent has been unchanged for 15 months (§ 558 Abs. 1 Satz 1 BGB), counted from the date the last increase was first due (BGH, VIII ZR 178/03). Increases for modernisation or service charges do not count.

kappung.title: Cap on increases (Kappungsgrenze)
kappung.text: In Berlin, increases under § 558 BGB may raise the rent by at most 15 % in three years (§ 558 Abs. 3 BGB, Berliner Kappungsgrenzenverordnung of 14.03.2023, valid until 10.05.2028). The starting point is the rent three years before the day the new rent is to apply (BGH, VIII ZR 177/03). Increases of the cold rent after a modernisation (§ 559 BGB) do not count: the 15 % is calculated without them, and they may come on top. Changes to the advance payments for service charges are not part of it.

burden_of_proof.title: Who has to prove what?
burden_of_proof.text: In a court case, the landlord has to prove the local comparative rent (BGH, VIII ZR 123/20, Rn. 27). On the features, the Landgericht Berlin (Berlin Regional Court, today Landgericht Berlin II) decided: as a rule, the landlord has to prove plus features, and you have to prove minus features you rely on (LG Berlin, 67 S 150/18, Rn. 6–9). Other courts may see it differently.

lwu.title: State-owned housing companies
lwu.text: At degewo, GESOBAU, Gewobag, HOWOGE, STADT UND LAND and WBM, additional voluntary commitments apply as long as the cooperation agreement (Kooperationsvereinbarung) runs (until 31.12.2027): at most 11 % more in three years (alliance agreement of 15.07.2025) and at most €50 (up to 65 m²), €75 (up to 100 m²) or €100 (up to 125 m²) more per month (Kooperationsvereinbarung II.8). We calculate the euro limit only for this one increase; the agreement does not say explicitly whether it applies to the whole term. If there has already been an increase under § 558 BGB since 01.01.2024, the limit may then be lower; if in doubt, ask the ombudsman office (Ombudsstelle). Not included in the calculation is a target rule (Soll-Regel) from a Berlin law (at most 15 % more in four years), which in individual cases can result in a lower limit. There is also the affordability promise (Leistbarkeitsversprechen): on application, a net cold rent of at most 27 % of household income, if the income and floor-space limits are met. The cooperation agreement also applies to flats in the “Klassisches Wohnen” (classic housing) area that berlinovo owns itself, not to flats of its fund companies (Fondsgesellschaften).

pay_from.title: From when you would pay
pay_from.text: The later of two days: the earliest day under the law or the date the landlord names. We put this date into the letter.

consent_deadline_193.title: Deadline for consent: next working day
consent_deadline_193.text: If your deadline ends on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Berlin, the wording of § 193 BGB puts the next working day in its place. This date shows that day. Still, plan with the earlier date. Public holidays in Berlin include, for example, New Year’s Day, Women’s Day (8 March), Good Friday, Easter Monday, 1 May, Ascension Day, Whit Monday, 3 October and the two Christmas holidays.
